description: This Java interface defines the contract for a loan reschedule modal period, specifying methods to access various details about a loan schedule period, such as dates, amounts, and identifiers.

methods.name: toData
methods.description: Converts the period details to a data transfer object.

methods.name: oldPeriodNumber
methods.description: Returns the original period number if rescheduled.

methods.name: periodFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the period.

methods.name: periodDueDate
methods.description: Returns the due date for the period.

methods.name: isNew
methods.description: Indicates whether this period is a new rescheduled period.
